== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Commence Primary Ignition (Japanese)|Commence Primary Ignition]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 161939281.

Crop rectangle <code>(141, 608, 1307, 2238)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7edca4a1ea26d41dc85f9d62f8df523f5f6d0d97268e4077e87e2f5619752bb4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
